Architecture/block diagram (Figure A6.1, "Refactored layers model derived form IG1373 SD-WAN Use Case"), presented in the Appendix as the **canonical master diagram** from which the other members of this diagram family (`sdwan-osi-layered-service-model-with-underlay-clouds.png` and `sdwan-osi-layered-service-model-mef-mapping-view.png`) are derived by hiding layers not relevant to each section's discussion.

The overall layout matches the other two views — Management/Control Plane L3/Control Plane L3-2.5/Control Plane L2/User Plane L1/Infrastructure Plane L0 bands, the lettered A–H key, the "e2e Service Management Operational Domain" with the "Service Management Intelligent Controller (SMIC)" box, the "SD-WAN Operational Domain" with Provider Edge Router / Virtual Provider Edge Router / SDWAN Controller and SWVC/TVC/UCS connections, and the "IP Underlay Service" box with IPVC Controller and MPLS/internet/cellular cloud icons — but this canonical version additionally shows the full L0/L1 physical layer detail that the other two views omit:

- **User Plane L1**: an **"SFP"** box on each side (under the Provider Edge Router and Virtual Provider Edge Router), with **"GPON fibre"** and **"Ethernet"** lines feeding the left SFP, a **"DWDM Filter"** icon on each side, and a **"fibre"** line (with a double-headed arrow) running the full width between the two DWDM Filters, alongside the "Fibre Transport Service" and "Fibre Management System & Inventory" boxes.
- **Infrastructure Plane L0**: a **"Line plant Mngt System & Inventory"** box and an **"Infrastructure Service"** box, connected by a physical line running through a row of red **"Ducts Pits Frames"** icons (including one explicitly labelled **"Pit"** and a **"Duct"** label) spanning between the two sides — the physical duct/pit/frame infrastructure carrying the fibre.

As the canonical source diagram, this view carries the most complete physical-layer detail (SFP/GPON/DWDM/duct-and-pit infrastructure) of the three related layered-service-model figures in this document.
